platform: Common App / Coalition with Scoir / QuestBridge
deadline_note: Regular Decision 4 Jan 2027; Early Decision 1 Nov 2026; QuestBridge 1 Oct 2026 (Northwestern 'Application dates and deadlines' page).

tuition_intl.note: Tuition 2025-26 from Northwestern's Common Data Set 2024-25 (G1); excludes fees, housing and food.

aid_intl.en: Need-aware for international applicants, but Northwestern meets 100% of demonstrated need for all admitted first-years for four years. Need-based aid only; no merit scholarships.

tests.en: Test-optional: SAT/ACT not required (scores may be submitted). English proficiency score required if English is not your first language or school language (TOEFL iBT, IELTS incl. Indicator, Duolingo); no minimum, but competitive applicants score in the high range.

gpa_note.en: Most admitted students rank in the top 10% of their class with the most rigorous curriculum available.

scholarships.name: Northwestern need-based financial aid (international students eligible)
QuestBridge National College Match

summary.en: A private research university on Lake Michigan just north of Chicago, famous for journalism, economics, engineering and the performing arts. It is need-aware for international students but meets full demonstrated need for everyone it admits.
summary.ka: კერძო კვლევითი უნივერსიტეტი მიჩიგანის ტბის სანაპიროზე, ჩიკაგოს ჩრდილოეთით, რომელიც ცნობილია ჟურნალისტიკით, ეკონომიკით, ინჟინერიითა და საშემსრულებლო ხელოვნებით. საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებისთვის need-aware-ია, მაგრამ ყველა ჩარიცხულის დადასტურებულ საჭიროებას სრულად ფარავს.
summary.ar: جامعة بحثية خاصة على بحيرة ميشيغان شمال شيكاغو، تشتهر بالصحافة والاقتصاد والهندسة والفنون الأدائية. تراعي الحاجة المالية عند قبول الدوليين، لكنها تغطي الحاجة المثبتة كاملة لكل من تقبله.

about.en:
Northwestern's six undergraduate schools include the Medill School of Journalism, the McCormick School of Engineering, the School of Communication and the Bienen School of Music, alongside the Weinberg College of Arts and Sciences. Students apply to a specific school, can double-major across schools and use the quarter system to take many courses.

The Evanston campus sits on the lakefront 20 minutes from downtown Chicago, giving access to internships in finance, media and consulting. In fall 2025 the university admitted about 7.7% of 49,474 first-year applicants (Common Data Set).

label.en: Secondary school transcript (grades from the last 3-4 years)
SAT/ACT scores (optional: test-optional policy)
English test: required for non-native speakers (TOEFL / IELTS / Duolingo; no fixed minimum)
Common App personal essay (up to 650 words)
Northwestern 'Why Northwestern' supplemental essay
School counselor report + 1 teacher recommendation
Application fee (USD 75); fee waivers available for eligible applicants
Interview (optional / offered to some applicants)
Financial aid forms if requesting aid (CSS Profile and/or the university's international aid form)

name.en: University of California, San Diego (UC San Diego)

deadline_note: One UC application covers all campuses. Fall 2027 filing period: 1-30 November 2026 (UC 'Dates & deadlines' page). No early decision/action.

tuition_intl.note: UC tuition incl. nonresident supplemental tuition, estimated for new nonresident undergraduates 2027-28 (UC tuition & cost page); campus fees, housing and food extra.

aid_intl.en: International students are not eligible for US federal or California state need-based aid. Campus scholarships for international first-years are very limited; plan to fund the full cost.

tests.en: Test-blind: SAT/ACT scores are not considered for admission. English (if required): IELTS 6.5, Duolingo 115, or TOEFL iBT 80 (tests before Jan 2026) / 4.5 on the new 1-6 scale (from Jan 2026). Some majors or campuses may expect more.

gpa_note.en: Middle 50% weighted high-school GPA of fall 2026 admits: 4.12-4.28 (UC admit data).

summary.en: A top public research university on the Pacific coast, strong in biology, engineering, computer science and ocean science. Admission is test-blind and handled through the single UC application.
summary.ka: წამყვანი საჯარო კვლევითი უნივერსიტეტი წყნარი ოკეანის სანაპიროზე, ძლიერი ბიოლოგიაში, ინჟინერიაში, კომპიუტერულ მეცნიერებასა და ოკეანოლოგიაში. მიღებისას SAT/ACT არ განიხილება და განაცხადი ერთიანი UC სისტემით იგზავნება.
summary.ar: جامعة بحثية حكومية رائدة على ساحل المحيط الهادئ، قوية في الأحياء والهندسة وعلوم الحاسوب وعلوم المحيطات. لا تُعتبر اختبارات SAT/ACT في القبول، ويتم التقديم عبر طلب UC الموحد.

about.en:
UC San Diego organises undergraduates into eight residential colleges, each with its own general-education programme, inside a large research university that includes the Scripps Institution of Oceanography and a major medical school. It is especially known for biological sciences, bioengineering, cognitive science and computing.

Applicants choose a major (some, like computer science, are capped and very competitive). UC San Diego received 141,767 first-year applications for fall 2026 and admitted 27.2% (UC admit data).

label.en: Secondary school transcript (grades from the last 3-4 years)
No SAT/ACT needed (scores not considered)
English test: IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL 80 (old scale) or 4.5 (new scale) / Duolingo 115
UC Personal Insight Questions (answer 4 of 8, up to 350 words each)
Self-reported academic record (grades entered directly into the UC application)
Application fee (USD 95 per campus); fee waivers available for eligible applicants
Proof of funds / certification of finances for the I-20 or study permit (after admission)
Valid passport (needed for the visa / study permit)

name.en: The University of Texas at Austin

deadline_note: International first-year: Early Action 15 Oct 2026 (materials by 22 Oct), Regular 1 Dec 2026 (materials by 10 Dec). Early Action decisions by 15 Jan 2027, regular by 15 Feb 2027 (UT international applicants page).

tuition_intl.note: Non-resident tuition varies by college and major; check UT's tuition rates page.

aid_intl.en: Limited: international students are not eligible for federal or Texas state aid. Some merit scholarships from colleges and departments; most internationals must show full funding for the I-20.

tests.en: SAT or ACT required (send at least one official score). English: TOEFL iBT 79 (or 4 on the new 6-point scale), IELTS Academic 6.5 overall, or Duolingo 115, unless exempt as a citizen of a sole-English-official-language country.

summary.en: Texas' flagship public university in the state capital, with top programmes in engineering, business, computer science and communication. International applicants must submit SAT or ACT scores.
summary.ka: ტეხასის წამყვანი საჯარო უნივერსიტეტი შტატის დედაქალაქში, ინჟინერიის, ბიზნესის, კომპიუტერული მეცნიერებისა და კომუნიკაციის ძლიერი პროგრამებით. საერთაშორისო აპლიკანტებისთვის SAT ან ACT სავალდებულოა.
summary.ar: الجامعة الحكومية الرئيسية في ولاية تكساس بعاصمتها أوستن، ولديها برامج قوية في الهندسة والأعمال وعلوم الحاسوب والاتصال. يجب على المتقدمين الدوليين تقديم درجات SAT أو ACT.

about.en:
UT Austin is one of the largest universities in the US, with 18 colleges and schools. Applicants choose a first and second-choice major; competitive programmes such as computer science, McCombs business and Cockrell engineering admit far fewer students than they receive. Austin is a fast-growing tech hub, which helps with internships.

International first-year applicants apply through ApplyTexas or the Common App, pay a USD 90 fee, submit an essay, SAT/ACT and an English test, and can add an optional short answer and up to two recommendation letters.

label.en: Secondary school transcript (grades from the last 3-4 years)
SAT or ACT scores (required)
English test: TOEFL 79 / IELTS 6.5 / Duolingo 115
Required essay (ApplyTexas or Common App) plus short answers
Recommendation letter(s) where requested by the programme
Expanded resume (activities, awards, work)
Application fee (USD 90); fee waivers available for eligible applicants
Proof of funds / certification of finances for the I-20 or study permit (after admission)
Valid passport (needed for the visa / study permit)

deadline_note: Regular Decision 5 Jan; Early Decision 1 Nov (Brown first-year admission page, current cycle).

tuition_intl.note: Tuition on Brown's financial-aid cost page (current year); fees about USD 3,084, total on-campus cost about USD 99,000.

aid_intl.en: Need-blind for international students (from the Class of 2029 onwards) and Brown meets 100% of demonstrated need for admitted students who apply for aid when they apply. Need-based only; no merit awards.

tests.en: SAT or ACT required (superscored; no minimum). English test highly recommended for non-native speakers; expected minimums: TOEFL 105 (before Jan 2026) or 5.5 (new scale), IELTS 8.0, Duolingo 130.

scholarships.name: Brown need-based financial aid for international students

summary.en: An Ivy League university known for its Open Curriculum, which lets students design their own path with no core requirements. Brown is now need-blind for international applicants and meets full need.
summary.ka: აივი ლიგის უნივერსიტეტი, რომელიც ცნობილია ღია სასწავლო გეგმით (Open Curriculum): სტუდენტები სავალდებულო საგნების გარეშე თავად აწყობენ სწავლის გზას. ბრაუნი ახლა საერთაშორისო აპლიკანტებისთვის need-blind-ია და სრულ საჭიროებას ფარავს.
summary.ar: جامعة من رابطة اللبلاب تشتهر بالمنهج المفتوح الذي يتيح للطلاب تصميم مسارهم دون مقررات إلزامية. أصبحت براون لا تأخذ الحاجة المالية في الاعتبار عند قبول الدوليين وتغطي الحاجة كاملة.

about.en:
Brown's Open Curriculum has no distribution requirements: students choose from 80+ concentrations, may take any course pass/fail and often combine fields. The Program in Liberal Medical Education offers an eight-year BA/MD track, and a dual degree with the Rhode Island School of Design is available.

About 14% of Brown's students come from abroad. Admission is extremely selective, SAT/ACT scores are required again, and international applicants are reviewed need-blind.

label.en: Secondary school transcript (grades from the last 3-4 years)
SAT or ACT scores (required)
English test: recommended: TOEFL 105 / 5.5, IELTS 8.0, Duolingo 130
Common App personal essay (up to 650 words)
Brown supplemental essays
School counselor report + 2 teacher recommendations
Application fee (USD 75); fee waivers available for eligible applicants
Interview (optional / offered to some applicants)
Financial aid forms if requesting aid (CSS Profile and/or the university's international aid form)

deadline_note: Single first-year deadline 15 Nov 2026 for summer/autumn 2027 (UW 'Dates & deadlines' page). No early decision/action.

tuition_intl.note: Non-resident tuition (international students pay this rate), current year, UW cost-of-attendance page; total budget about USD 55,000-73,000.

aid_intl.en: None: UW does not provide financial aid or scholarships to undergraduate international students, who must be prepared to cover all expenses.

tests.en: SAT/ACT no longer required for most applicants (required only for homeschooled students or schools without standard grades). International applicants must submit TOEFL iBT 76 (before 21 Jan 2026) or 4.0 (new scale), IELTS 6.0, or Duolingo 110 unless exempt.

gpa_note.en: Middle 50% admitted high-school GPA (autumn 2025): 3.75-3.98 on a 4.0 scale (95-100 on a 100 scale).

summary.en: Washington's flagship public research university in Seattle, a powerhouse in computer science, medicine and engineering next to tech giants like Microsoft and Amazon. Test scores are optional, but there is no aid for international undergraduates.
summary.ka: ვაშინგტონის შტატის წამყვანი საჯარო კვლევითი უნივერსიტეტი სიეტლში — ძლიერი კომპიუტერულ მეცნიერებაში, მედიცინასა და ინჟინერიაში, Microsoft-ისა და Amazon-ის მეზობლად. ტესტები არასავალდებულოა, მაგრამ საერთაშორისო ბაკალავრებისთვის ფინანსური დახმარება არ არსებობს.
summary.ar: الجامعة البحثية الحكومية الرئيسية في ولاية واشنطن بمدينة سياتل، وهي قوة في علوم الحاسوب والطب والهندسة بجوار شركات مثل مايكروسوفت وأمازون. الاختبارات اختيارية، لكن لا توجد مساعدات مالية لطلاب البكالوريوس الدوليين.

about.en:
The UW's Seattle campus is one of the largest research universities in the US, with the Paul G. Allen School of Computer Science & Engineering, a leading medical school and strong programmes in oceanography and environmental science. Some majors, including computer science and engineering, admit students directly to the major, with lower admit rates.

The UW reviews applications holistically. Its 3-year average admit rate for non-Washington residents is 39% (37% for direct-to-college engineering). International students pay non-resident tuition and should plan to fund the full cost.

deadline_note: Early Action deadline 1 Nov 2026 is the one key first-year date; after that applications are reviewed on a rolling basis and options become more competitive, especially at University Park. Schreyer Honors College has earlier dates (Penn State international deadlines page).

tuition_intl.note: Out-of-state/international tuition varies by campus, college and year level; see tuition.psu.edu.

aid_intl.en: Limited: international students are not eligible for US federal aid; some college and campus scholarships may be available. Expect to show full funding for the I-20.

tests.en: Test-optional: SAT/ACT not required (can be used to prove English). English proof for non-native speakers: Duolingo 120, TOEFL iBT 80 (before 21 Jan 2026) or 4.5 (new scale), IELTS Academic 6.5; SAT EBRW 570 or ACT English 24 also accepted.

summary.en: A huge public research university with its main campus at University Park and 20 campuses across Pennsylvania, known for engineering, business and meteorology. It is test-optional and reviews applications on a rolling basis after 1 November.
summary.ka: უზარმაზარი საჯარო კვლევითი უნივერსიტეტი, მთავარი კამპუსით University Park-ში და 20 კამპუსით მთელ პენსილვანიაში; ცნობილია ინჟინერიით, ბიზნესითა და მეტეოროლოგიით. ტესტები არასავალდებულოა და 1 ნოემბრის შემდეგ განაცხადები მოძრავი წესით განიხილება.
summary.ar: جامعة بحثية حكومية ضخمة حرمها الرئيسي في University Park ولها 20 حرمًا في أنحاء بنسلفانيا، وتشتهر بالهندسة والأعمال والأرصاد الجوية. الاختبارات اختيارية، وتُراجع الطلبات بشكل متجدد بعد 1 نوفمبر.

about.en:
Penn State is a land-grant university with one of the largest alumni networks in the world. Students apply to a specific campus and major; University Park is the most competitive campus, while the Commonwealth campuses offer smaller classes and a '2+2' path to finish at University Park.

The Schreyer Honors College is a separate, selective honours programme with its own earlier application. International applicants must submit official transcripts with a marking key, proof of English, and financial documents for the I-20.

Personal statement (optional for most programmes, recommended)

deadline_note: Applications open 1 Oct 2026; deadline 1 Mar 2027 for most programmes (some faculties differ). Application-based entrance scholarships due 10 Jan 2027; documents by 1 Aug 2027 (U of A dates & deadlines page).

tuition_intl.note: International tuition is set per programme with a 4-year tuition guarantee (annual and programme total) shown in the offer; use the U of A cost calculator.

aid_intl.en: Merit scholarships for international students: automatic International Admission Scholarship (up to CAD 10,000) and application-based awards such as the President's International Distinction Scholarship (up to CAD 120,000 over 4 years).

tests.en: SAT/ACT not required. English: IELTS Academic 6.5 (no band below 6.0), TOEFL iBT 90 (no section below 21) or 4.5 on the new scale (no band below 4.5), Duolingo 120 (no subscore below 100). Some programmes (e.g. Education, Nursing) also require spoken-English scores.

scholarships.name: International Admission Scholarship (automatic, up to CAD 10,000)
President's International Distinction Scholarship (up to CAD 120,000 over 4 years)
U of A Global Citizen Scholarship (IB Diploma / Aga Khan Academy students; full tuition + living)

summary.en: One of Canada's top five research universities, in Edmonton, with particular strength in artificial intelligence, engineering, energy and health sciences. It offers generous merit scholarships to international students and a guaranteed four-year tuition price.
summary.ka: კანადის ხუთ საუკეთესო კვლევით უნივერსიტეტს შორის — ედმონტონში, განსაკუთრებით ძლიერი ხელოვნურ ინტელექტში, ინჟინერიაში, ენერგეტიკასა და ჯანდაცვის მეცნიერებებში. საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებს სთავაზობს გულუხვ სტიპენდიებს და ოთხწლიან ფიქსირებულ სწავლის საფასურს.
summary.ar: من أفضل خمس جامعات بحثية في كندا، تقع في إدمونتون، وتتميز خصوصًا في الذكاء الاصطناعي والهندسة والطاقة والعلوم الصحية. تقدم منحًا سخية للتفوق للطلاب الدوليين وسعرًا مضمونًا للرسوم طوال أربع سنوات.

about.en:
The U of A has over 200 undergraduate programmes and about 8,000 international students from 156 countries. It is home to the Alberta Machine Intelligence Institute (Amii), making it a world centre for reinforcement learning and AI research, and is known for engineering and energy-related fields.

Applications open on 1 October and most programmes close on 1 March. Admission is based on grades in specific prerequisite subjects for your curriculum; scholarships are assessed automatically with your application or, for the big awards, via a separate application by 10 January.

Secondary school diploma / final exam results (predicted results accepted when applying)

Programme prerequisite subjects (check requirements for your curriculum)

deadline_note: Fall 2027: Early Action 1 Nov 2026 (materials by 9 Nov, decision by 31 Jan); Regular Decision 15 Jan 2027 (materials by 22 Jan, decision by 31 Mar) (UW-Madison deadlines page).

tuition_intl.note: Non-resident tuition & fees (current year) from UW-Madison cost-of-attendance page; international students pay an additional international student fee.

aid_intl.en: Very limited for international undergraduates (not eligible for federal aid); some departmental scholarships may be available after enrolment.

tests.en: SAT/ACT optional through spring 2028. English (if educated in a non-English-speaking country): Duolingo 115+, IELTS Academic 6.5+, TOEFL iBT 80 (test before 21 Jan 2026) or 4.5 (new scale).

summary.en: A leading Big Ten public research university on the lakes of Wisconsin's capital, strong across engineering, life sciences, economics and the social sciences. SAT/ACT are optional and there are both Early Action and Regular Decision rounds.
summary.ka: Big Ten-ის წამყვანი საჯარო კვლევითი უნივერსიტეტი ვისკონსინის დედაქალაქის ტბებთან, ძლიერი ინჟინერიაში, ბიოლოგიურ მეცნიერებებში, ეკონომიკასა და სოციალურ მეცნიერებებში. SAT/ACT არასავალდებულოა; არის Early Action და Regular Decision რაუნდები.
summary.ar: جامعة بحثية حكومية رائدة في مؤتمر Big Ten على بحيرات عاصمة ولاية ويسكونسن، قوية في الهندسة وعلوم الحياة والاقتصاد والعلوم الاجتماعية. اختبارات SAT/ACT اختيارية، وهناك جولتا Early Action وRegular Decision.

about.en:
UW-Madison is one of the original public research universities in the US, with more than 200 majors and a famously lively campus between Lake Mendota and Lake Monona. It is particularly strong in engineering, computer sciences, biochemistry, economics and journalism.

International applicants apply through the Common App and must send official secondary school records (including exam results such as IB, A-Levels or national exams) and English test scores. Tuition is charged at the non-resident rate plus an international student fee.

deadline_note: One UC application covers all campuses. Fall 2027 filing period: 1-30 November 2026 (UC 'Dates & deadlines' page). No early decision/action.

tuition_intl.note: UC tuition incl. nonresident supplemental tuition, estimated for new nonresident undergraduates 2027-28 (UC tuition & cost page); campus fees, housing and food extra.

aid_intl.en: International students are not eligible for US federal or California state need-based aid. Campus scholarships for international first-years are very limited; plan to fund the full cost.

tests.en: Test-blind: SAT/ACT scores are not considered for admission. English (if required): IELTS 6.5, Duolingo 115, or TOEFL iBT 80 (tests before Jan 2026) / 4.5 on the new 1-6 scale (from Jan 2026). Some majors or campuses may expect more.

summary.en: A large University of California campus in a bike-friendly college town near Sacramento, world-leading in agriculture, veterinary-related sciences and the environment. Admission is test-blind through the UC application.
summary.ka: კალიფორნიის უნივერსიტეტის დიდი კამპუსი ველოსიპედების ქალაქში, საკრამენტოს მახლობლად — მსოფლიო ლიდერი სოფლის მეურნეობაში, ვეტერინარიასთან დაკავშირებულ მეცნიერებებსა და გარემოს დაცვაში. SAT/ACT არ განიხილება, განაცხადი UC სისტემით იგზავნება.
summary.ar: حرم كبير لجامعة كاليفورنيا في مدينة جامعية صديقة للدراجات قرب ساكرامنتو، رائد عالميًا في الزراعة والعلوم البيطرية والبيئة. لا تُعتبر اختبارات SAT/ACT، ويتم التقديم عبر طلب UC.

about.en:
UC Davis is one of the largest UC campuses, with colleges of agricultural and environmental sciences, biological sciences, engineering, and letters and science. It is globally known for agriculture, plant and animal science, food science and wine-making (viticulture and enology), and for its veterinary school.

For fall 2026 UC Davis received 104,864 first-year applications and admitted 45.8% (UC admit data). International students pay UC nonresident tuition and receive little institutional aid.

No SAT/ACT needed (scores not considered)
English test: IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL 80 (old scale) or 4.5 (new scale) / Duolingo 115

Application fee (USD 95 per campus); fee waivers available for eligible applicants

platform: Common App / Coalition with Scoir / QuestBridge
deadline_note: Regular Decision 4 Jan 2027 (decisions by 1 Apr); Early Decision I 1 Nov 2026; Early Decision II 4 Jan 2027 (Rice first-year international applicants page).

tuition_intl.note: See Rice financial aid cost of attendance page for the current figure.

aid_intl.en: Need-aware for international applicants: Rice offers need-based aid to a limited number of international first-years, and the amount requested can be considered in admission.

tests.en: Test-optional, but Rice recommends submitting SAT or ACT if available. English for non-native speakers: TOEFL iBT 100 (or 5.0 new scale), IELTS Academic 7.0, Duolingo 130, Cambridge C1/C2 185.

scholarships.name: Rice need-based aid for international students (limited, need-aware)

summary.en: A small, highly selective private research university in Houston with a residential college system and outstanding engineering, sciences, architecture and music. International applicants are considered need-aware.
summary.ka: პატარა, მაღალშერჩევითი კერძო კვლევითი უნივერსიტეტი ჰიუსტონში, საცხოვრებელი კოლეჯების სისტემით და გამორჩეული ინჟინერიით, მეცნიერებებით, არქიტექტურითა და მუსიკით. საერთაშორისო აპლიკანტები need-aware პრინციპით განიხილებიან.
summary.ar: جامعة بحثية خاصة صغيرة وانتقائية جدًا في هيوستن، بنظام كليات سكنية وبرامج متميزة في الهندسة والعلوم والعمارة والموسيقى. يُنظر في طلبات الدوليين مع مراعاة الحاجة المالية.

about.en:
Rice has about 4,500 undergraduates split among 11 residential colleges, a low student-faculty ratio and easy access to research next to the Texas Medical Center, the largest medical complex in the world. Engineering, computer science, the natural sciences, architecture and the Shepherd School of Music are standouts.

The application includes Rice-specific essays and 'The Box', where you share an image that says something about you. The application fee is USD 75 and international applicants cannot request a fee waiver.

deadline_note: Apply by 1 Feb 2027 for programmes other than Engineering (documents and Admission Information Form by 15 Feb); Engineering apply by 15 Jan 2027 (documents by 1 Feb) plus a required online interview. International students have the same deadlines (Waterloo deadlines page).

tuition_intl.note: International tuition varies by programme; Waterloo's tuition page and cost calculator give per-programme figures.

aid_intl.en: Every international fee-paying student admitted to full-time first-year degree studies receives a CAD 10,000 International Student Entrance Scholarship (no application). International students are automatically considered for most other entrance scholarships.

tests.en: SAT/ACT not required. English: TOEFL iBT 90 (25 writing, 25 speaking) for tests before 21 Jan 2026, or 4.5 overall (5 writing, 5 speaking) after; IELTS Academic 6.5 (6.5 writing and speaking, 6.0 reading and listening); Duolingo 120 with Literacy and Production 125.

scholarships.name: International Student Entrance Scholarship (CAD 10,000, automatic)

summary.en: Canada's leading university for computer science, mathematics and engineering, famous for the world's largest co-op programme alternating study terms with paid work terms. Every international first-year receives a CAD 10,000 entrance scholarship.
summary.ka: კანადის წამყვანი უნივერსიტეტი კომპიუტერულ მეცნიერებაში, მათემატიკასა და ინჟინერიაში, ცნობილი მსოფლიოში უდიდესი co-op პროგრამით, სადაც სწავლა ანაზღაურებად სამუშაო ტერმინებს ენაცვლება. ყველა საერთაშორისო პირველკურსელი იღებს 10 000 კანადურ დოლარიან სტიპენდიას.
summary.ar: الجامعة الكندية الرائدة في علوم الحاسوب والرياضيات والهندسة، وتشتهر بأكبر برنامج تعاوني (co-op) في العالم يتناوب فيه الطلاب بين الدراسة والعمل المدفوع. يحصل كل طالب دولي في السنة الأولى على منحة دخول بقيمة 10,000 دولار كندي.

about.en:
Waterloo's co-operative education model lets students complete up to two years of paid work terms with employers such as Google, Microsoft and Shopify before graduating. Its Faculty of Mathematics (home of the David R. Cheriton School of Computer Science) and Faculty of Engineering are among the most competitive programmes in Canada.

International students apply through the OUAC 105 form, then complete Waterloo's Admission Information Form; Engineering applicants also take an online interview. Admission is based mainly on grades in prerequisite courses, with many programmes requiring averages in the 90s.

deadline_note: 2026-27 cycle: Early Action 1 (Georgia residents) 15 Oct 2026; Early Action 2 (non-Georgia residents, incl. international) 2 Nov 2026, documents by 16 Nov; Regular Decision 6 Jan 2027, documents by 22 Jan (Georgia Tech first-year deadlines page).

tuition_intl.note: Non-resident tuition applies; see Georgia Tech Bursar for current rates.

aid_intl.en: Very limited for international students (not eligible for federal or Georgia state aid); a few merit scholarships exist. Plan to fund the full non-resident cost.

tests.en: All international applicants must meet the University System of Georgia English requirement, e.g. TOEFL iBT 4.0 / 79 (pre-2026), IELTS Academic 6.5 recommended (6.0 minimum); Duolingo and an unscripted interview (InitialView/Vericant) are encouraged as extra evidence. SAT/ACT: see Georgia Tech's application review page.

summary.en: One of the top public technology universities in the US, in the heart of Atlanta, with elite engineering and computing programmes. Non-Georgia and international applicants can apply Early Action by early November.
summary.ka: აშშ-ის ერთ-ერთი საუკეთესო საჯარო ტექნოლოგიური უნივერსიტეტი ატლანტის ცენტრში, ელიტური ინჟინერიისა და კომპიუტინგის პროგრამებით. ჯორჯიის შტატის გარეთა და საერთაშორისო აპლიკანტებს შეუძლიათ Early Action-ით ნოემბრის დასაწყისამდე განაცხადის შეტანა.
summary.ar: من أفضل الجامعات التقنية الحكومية في الولايات المتحدة، في قلب أتلانتا، ببرامج نخبوية في الهندسة والحوسبة. يمكن للمتقدمين من خارج جورجيا والدوليين التقديم في جولة Early Action حتى أوائل نوفمبر.

about.en:
Georgia Tech's College of Engineering is one of the largest and highest-ranked in the US, and its College of Computing is equally strong. Students can join a large co-op and internship programme with Atlanta's companies.

The international first-year application fee is USD 85. Reviewers look closely at course rigour (e.g. mostly 6s and 7s for IB students), essays and English communication; Georgia Tech encourages an unscripted interview via InitialView or Vericant in addition to the required English test.

English test: USG-approved test: TOEFL 4.0 (79 old) / IELTS 6.5 recommended
Common App personal essay (up to 650 words)
Georgia Tech short-answer essay
School counselor report + 1 teacher recommendation
Application fee USD 85 for international applicants
Unscripted interview (InitialView/Vericant) encouraged

deadline_note: Fall 2027: Early Decision or Early Action 1 Nov 2026 (most majors; also the merit-scholarship deadline); Regular Decision 10 Jan 2027 for most majors, 1 Dec 2026 for performing-arts majors (USC first-year page).

tuition_intl.note: See USC cost of attendance page for current tuition.

aid_intl.en: No need-based aid for international applicants; all must document ability to pay the full cost at application. Internationals who apply by the early deadline are eligible for USC Merit Scholarships (a few thousand dollars up to full tuition).

tests.en: Test-optional for 2027-28 entry. English test required for all non-native speakers (no waivers): TOEFL 100 with 20+ per section (pre-21 Jan 2026) or 5 with 4+ per section (new), IELTS 7, Cambridge C1 Advanced 185, PTE 68, SAT EBRW 650 or ACT English 27. Duolingo is not on USC's list of approved exams.

scholarships.name: USC Merit Scholarships (incl. Trustee and Presidential; international applicants eligible)

summary.en: A large private research university in central Los Angeles, famous for film, business, communication and engineering, with a huge alumni network. Test-optional for 2027 entry, with merit scholarships open to international students.
summary.ka: დიდი კერძო კვლევითი უნივერსიტეტი ლოს-ანჯელესის ცენტრში, ცნობილი კინოთი, ბიზნესით, კომუნიკაციითა და ინჟინერიით, უზარმაზარი კურსდამთავრებულთა ქსელით. 2027 წლის მიღებაზე ტესტები არასავალდებულოა და დამსახურებაზე დაფუძნებული სტიპენდიები საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებისთვისაც ხელმისაწვდომია.
summary.ar: جامعة بحثية خاصة كبيرة في وسط لوس أنجلوس، تشتهر بالسينما والأعمال والاتصال والهندسة، ولها شبكة خريجين ضخمة. الاختبارات اختيارية للالتحاق في 2027، ومنح التفوق متاحة للطلاب الدوليين.

about.en:
USC's School of Cinematic Arts is one of the best-known film schools in the world, and the Marshall School of Business, Annenberg School for Communication and Journalism and Viterbi School of Engineering are all highly ranked. Students come from nearly 130 countries.

Applying by 1 November (Early Decision or Early Action) is needed for most majors to be considered for merit scholarships. USC gives no need-based aid to international students, and all international applicants must submit an approved English exam with no exceptions.

tuition_intl.note: See MSU tuition and fees page; international students pay non-resident rates.

aid_intl.en: No need-based aid for international students, but MSU awards several merit scholarships to incoming first-years with non-US residency; the admission application is usually all that is needed, and applying by 1 Nov gives maximum consideration.

tests.en: Test-optional: SAT/ACT not required for admission or scholarships. English for regular admission: TOEFL iBT 79 (no subscore below 17) before 21 Jan 2026, or 4 (no section below 4, 3.5 speaking) after; IELTS 6.5; Duolingo 110. Lower scores may qualify for provisional admission with English study.

scholarships.name: MSU international student scholarships (automatic consideration)

summary.en: A large Big Ten public research university near Michigan's capital, top-ranked for supply chain management, education and nuclear physics. It is test-optional and offers merit scholarships to international first-years.
summary.ka: დიდი Big Ten საჯარო კვლევითი უნივერსიტეტი მიჩიგანის დედაქალაქთან ახლოს, წამყვანი მიწოდების ჯაჭვის მართვაში, განათლებასა და ბირთვულ ფიზიკაში. ტესტები არასავალდებულოა და საერთაშორისო პირველკურსელებს დამსახურებაზე დაფუძნებულ სტიპენდიებს სთავაზობს.
summary.ar: جامعة بحثية حكومية كبيرة في مؤتمر Big Ten قرب عاصمة ميشيغان، تحتل مراتب عليا في إدارة سلاسل الإمداد والتعليم والفيزياء النووية. الاختبارات اختيارية، وتقدم منح تفوق للطلاب الدوليين الجدد.

about.en:
MSU is a land-grant university with 200+ programmes, a huge residential campus in East Lansing and the Facility for Rare Isotope Beams, a major US nuclear physics laboratory. Its Broad College of Business is well known for supply chain management, and it has strong programmes in agriculture, education, communication and hospitality.

Admission has no fixed minimums. Applying Early Action by 1 November guarantees a decision by 15 January and maximum consideration for international scholarships; after that, applications are reviewed on a rolling basis until 1 April.

summary.en: A highly selective private research university in St. Louis, especially strong in medicine-related sciences, business and engineering. From fall 2027 it adds an Early Action round alongside Early and Regular Decision.
summary.ka: მაღალშერჩევითი კერძო კვლევითი უნივერსიტეტი სენტ-ლუისში, განსაკუთრებით ძლიერი მედიცინასთან დაკავშირებულ მეცნიერებებში, ბიზნესსა და ინჟინერიაში. 2027 წლის შემოდგომიდან Early და Regular Decision-ს ემატება Early Action რაუნდი.
summary.ar: جامعة بحثية خاصة شديدة الانتقائية في سانت لويس، قوية خصوصًا في العلوم المرتبطة بالطب والأعمال والهندسة. ابتداءً من خريف 2027 تضيف جولة Early Action إلى جانب Early وRegular Decision.

about.en:
WashU combines a mid-sized undergraduate body with a world-class medical school, making it a magnet for pre-med and life-science students. Undergraduates apply to one of five schools: Arts & Sciences, Olin Business School, McKelvey School of Engineering, Sam Fox School of Design & Visual Arts, or the new interdisciplinary programmes.

The application includes optional video and portfolio elements. International students from non-US schools can choose which standardised results to present (SAT/ACT, IB, A-Levels or national exams), and must show English proficiency if English is not their first language.

deadline_note: Fall 2027 undergraduate deadline for applicants studying outside Quebec is 1 Feb 2027 for most programmes; some programmes have earlier dates (e.g. 1 Nov or 15 Jan for Music). Check the programme page (UdeM 'dates limites' page).

tuition_intl.note: International tuition is high but most international students can receive the UdeM exemption scholarship that reduces it; use the registrar's tuition calculator.

aid_intl.en: UdeM exemption scholarship (bourse d'exemption) reduces international tuition for admitted bachelor's students, based on academic excellence; French and Belgian francophone applicants are excluded because they already pay reduced rates.

tests.en: Teaching is in French; programmes may require proof of French proficiency. SAT/ACT not required. No English test needed.

scholarships.name: Bourse d'exemption UdeM (international tuition exemption)

summary.en: Quebec's largest French-language university and a world centre for artificial intelligence research through the Mila institute. Most international bachelor's students can receive an exemption scholarship that cuts international tuition.
summary.ka: კვებეკის უდიდესი ფრანგულენოვანი უნივერსიტეტი და ხელოვნური ინტელექტის კვლევის მსოფლიო ცენტრი Mila ინსტიტუტის წყალობით. საერთაშორისო ბაკალავრების უმეტესობას შეუძლია მიიღოს გათავისუფლების სტიპენდია, რომელიც საერთაშორისო საფასურს ამცირებს.
summary.ar: أكبر جامعة ناطقة بالفرنسية في كيبيك ومركز عالمي لأبحاث الذكاء الاصطناعي عبر معهد Mila. يمكن لمعظم طلاب البكالوريوس الدوليين الحصول على منحة إعفاء تخفض الرسوم الدولية.

about.en:
The Université de Montréal and its affiliated schools (Polytechnique Montréal and HEC Montréal) form one of the largest university complexes in Canada. It is especially known for medicine, law, pharmacy, psychology and AI research through Mila, founded by Yoshua Bengio.

All teaching is in French. Applications are made directly to UdeM; the application fee is CAD 83.40 per term of admission plus a per-programme fee. The exemption scholarship value depends on academic excellence as shown in the transcripts submitted with the application.

Secondary school diploma / final exam results (predicted results accepted when applying)
French proficiency (programme-dependent test or proof of French-language schooling)

Programme-specific tests or interviews where required

deadline_note: Deadlines vary by programme (Health Sciences and other supplementary-application programmes close earliest); McMaster publishes them through its deadline search tool for 'International (not current Ontario high school)' applicants. Apply on OUAC by mid-January to be safe.

tuition_intl.note: International tuition varies by programme; see McMaster's cost estimator.

aid_intl.en: Limited entrance scholarships for international students; no need-based aid at entry. Check McMaster's scholarships pages.

tests.en: SAT/ACT not required. English: TOEFL iBT 86 (20+ each section) before 21 Jan 2026 or 4.5 overall (4.0 reading/writing/speaking, 4.5 listening) after; IELTS Academic 6.5 (6.0 each band); Duolingo 120 (115 reading, 125 writing, 110 listening, 115 speaking). Conditional offers with MELD/STEP English programmes possible.

summary.en: A research-intensive Ontario university famous for inventing problem-based learning in medicine, with an elite Health Sciences programme and strong engineering. Applications go through OUAC with programme-specific deadlines.
summary.ka: კვლევაზე ორიენტირებული ონტარიოს უნივერსიტეტი, რომელიც ცნობილია მედიცინაში პრობლემაზე დაფუძნებული სწავლების შექმნით, ელიტური Health Sciences პროგრამით და ძლიერი ინჟინერიით. განაცხადი OUAC-ით იგზავნება, პროგრამების მიხედვით განსხვავებული ვადებით.
summary.ar: جامعة بحثية في أونتاريو تشتهر بابتكار التعلم القائم على حل المشكلات في الطب، ولديها برنامج نخبوي في العلوم الصحية وهندسة قوية. يتم التقديم عبر OUAC بمواعيد تختلف حسب البرنامج.

about.en:
McMaster, in Hamilton about an hour from Toronto, is best known for health and medical research and for its Bachelor of Health Sciences (Honours), one of the most competitive undergraduate programmes in Canada. Engineering, kinesiology, nursing and the DeGroote School of Business are also popular.

International students apply through the OUAC 105 form; several programmes require a supplementary application. Students who meet the academic bar but fall short on English can receive offers conditional on McMaster's MELD or STEP programmes.

summary.en: A University of California campus on the Pacific coast with Nobel-winning physics and materials research and excellent environmental and marine science. Admission is test-blind through the UC application.

summary.ar: حرم لجامعة كاليفورنيا على ساحل المحيط الهادئ، يضم أبحاثًا حائزة على جائزة نوبل في الفيزياء وعلوم المواد، وبرامج ممتازة في علوم البيئة والبحار. لا تُعتبر اختبارات SAT/ACT، ويتم التقديم عبر طلب UC.

about.en:
UCSB sits on a beachfront campus near the city of Santa Barbara and combines a relaxed setting with serious research: it has several Nobel laureates on its faculty and is especially strong in physics, materials, chemical engineering, environmental science and marine biology. The College of Creative Studies offers a small, research-focused option for very motivated students.

For fall 2026 UCSB received 108,512 first-year applications and admitted 44.0% (UC admit data). International students pay UC nonresident tuition and receive little institutional aid.

summary.en: A leading private research university in Atlanta with a top business school, nursing and public health, and close ties to the CDC. Applicants can start at the main Atlanta campus or the small Oxford College campus.

summary.ar: جامعة بحثية خاصة رائدة في أتلانتا، لديها كلية أعمال قوية وبرامج متميزة في التمريض والصحة العامة، وروابط وثيقة بمراكز مكافحة الأمراض CDC. يمكن البدء في الحرم الرئيسي بأتلانتا أو في كلية أكسفورد الصغيرة.

about.en:
Emory College of Arts and Sciences and Oxford College form two entry points: Oxford students spend two years on a small liberal-arts campus before continuing at Emory in Atlanta. Students can later enter the Goizueta Business School or the Nell Hodgson Woodruff School of Nursing, and Emory's Rollins School of Public Health and the CDC next door make health fields especially strong.

Emory is test-optional. International students who need aid can apply, but need-based aid goes to a select group each year, so asking for aid may affect chances. The Emory University Scholar Programs offer merit awards up to the full cost of attendance.

Ohio State is a public land-grant university with very broad offerings, from the Fisher College of Business and a large College of Engineering to agriculture, medicine, communication and the arts. The Columbus campus is one of the biggest in the US, with a huge student community and big-time college sports.

International first-year applicants must submit ACT or SAT scores, proof of English and transcripts. Half of admitted students scored between 1280 and 1470 on the SAT.

about.en:
Queen's is a mid-sized, mostly residential university where most first-year students live on campus. Its Commerce programme at the Smith School of Business, its engineering faculty and Health Sciences are highly sought after, and Queen's also has the Bader College campus at Herstmonceux Castle in England for a first-year abroad.

International applicants use OUAC's 105 form. Commerce, Health Sciences and Nursing have earlier deadlines and mandatory supplementary applications; to compete for the large Major Admission Awards, apply early so you can access the award application on SOLUS.

about.en:
UMD's College Park campus is a short metro ride from Washington, D.C., giving students access to federal agencies, research labs such as NASA Goddard and NIST, and policy internships. Computer science, engineering, criminology and the Robert H. Smith School of Business are particularly strong.

International first-years use the same deadlines as US students. Applying Early Action gives priority consideration for admission and merit scholarships. English proficiency is required unless waived, and non-US credentials are evaluated by UMD.

UCalgary is one of Canada's top research universities, close to the Rocky Mountains, with the Schulich School of Engineering, the Haskayne School of Business and strong energy, environment and geoscience programmes tied to the city's industry. Its kinesiology faculty is among the best in the world.

Applications are made directly through UCalgary's online application. Admission is based mainly on grades in required high-school subjects for your curriculum.

UF is one of the largest universities in the US and a member of the Association of American Universities. It offers 300+ undergraduate programmes across 16 colleges, plus special pathways such as the online PaCE programme and the Innovation Academy (spring/summer schedule).

International applicants with a non-US high school do not submit the Florida STARS self-reported record but follow UF's international requirements. Test scores are required and must arrive by the materials deadline of the chosen round.

uOttawa sits in downtown Ottawa next to Parliament Hill, so political science, public administration, international affairs and law are natural strengths, alongside medicine, engineering and the Telfer School of Management. Students can take programmes in English, French or both, and many include co-op.

International applicants apply through OUAC. Because programmes reach capacity quickly, apply as soon as possible and before 15 January.

Rochester's 'Rochester Curriculum' has no general-education requirements beyond a primary major and clusters in other areas, giving students wide freedom. It hosts the Institute of Optics, the oldest optics programme in the US, the Eastman School of Music and a large medical centre.

For fall 2026 it received 22,558 first-year applications and admitted 9,842 (44%). Internationals who need aid submit the CSS Profile; others submit the International Financial Support Form. Optional items include a writing sample and a family/peer recommendation.

aid_intl.en: Universal need-blind admission, including international students, and Dartmouth meets 100% of demonstrated need.

tests.en: Standardized testing is required, but can be met in one of five ways: SAT or ACT (superscored), three AP exams, IB Diploma predicted/final results, or other routes listed on the testing-policy page. English proficiency evidence is reviewed for non-native speakers.

scholarships.name: Dartmouth need-based aid (universal need-blind, full need met)

summary.en: The smallest Ivy League school, a liberal-arts focused college in rural New Hampshire with a flexible quarter system and a very loyal alumni network. Admission is need-blind for everyone, including international students.
summary.ka: აივი ლიგის ყველაზე პატარა სკოლა — ლიბერალურ განათლებაზე ორიენტირებული კოლეჯი ნიუ-ჰემფშირის სოფლად, მოქნილი კვარტალური სისტემით და ძალიან ერთგული კურსდამთავრებულებით. მიღება ყველასთვის, მათ შორის საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებისთვის, need-blind-ია.
summary.ar: أصغر جامعات رابطة اللبلاب، كلية تركز على الفنون الحرة في ريف نيوهامبشير بنظام فصول مرن وشبكة خريجين وفية جدًا. القبول لا يأخذ الحاجة المالية في الاعتبار للجميع، بمن فيهم الطلاب الدوليون.

about.en:
Dartmouth's 'D-Plan' divides the year into four terms, letting students take off-terms for internships, research or study abroad. Undergraduates get close contact with faculty, and the Thayer School offers engineering within a liberal-arts setting.

Testing is required again but can be met through SAT/ACT, AP, IB or other routes. Dartmouth reviews every applicant need-blind and meets full demonstrated need.

label.en: Secondary school transcript (grades from the last 3-4 years)
SAT or ACT scores (required)
English test: evidence of English proficiency for non-native speakers
Common App personal essay (up to 650 words)
Dartmouth supplemental essays
School counselor report + 2 teacher recommendations
Optional peer recommendation
Application fee (see Dartmouth website); fee waivers available for eligible applicants
Interview (optional / offered to some applicants)
Financial aid forms if requesting aid (CSS Profile and/or the university's international aid form)

deadline_note: Early Decision I 1 Nov 2026; Early Decision II 1 Jan 2027; Regular Decision 1 Jan 2027 (aid forms due on the same dates for ED; 1 Feb 2027 for RD) - Vanderbilt international costs & finances page.

tuition_intl.note: See Vanderbilt cost of attendance; aid packages contain no loans.

aid_intl.en: Need-aware for international students who apply for aid (they compete among other international aid applicants). For fall 2026 Vanderbilt gave need-based aid and/or merit scholarships to 89 international students from 54 countries, worth USD 16,815-99,998 per year for four years.

tests.en: SAT/ACT optional for fall 2027 and 2028 entry (required again from fall 2029). Fall 2026 middle 50%: ACT 34-35, SAT EBRW 730-760, SAT Math 770-790. English test for non-native speakers (see Vanderbilt testing policies).

gpa_note.en: Fall 2026 middle 50%: ACT 34-35; SAT EBRW 730-760; SAT Math 770-790.

scholarships.name: Vanderbilt need-based aid & merit scholarships for international students

summary.en: A highly selective private research university in Nashville that admitted just 4.6% of applicants for fall 2026. SAT/ACT are optional for 2027 entry, and a limited number of international students receive generous need-based aid or merit scholarships.
summary.ka: მაღალშერჩევითი კერძო კვლევითი უნივერსიტეტი ნეშვილში, რომელმაც 2026 წლის შემოდგომაზე აპლიკანტების მხოლოდ 4.6% მიიღო. 2027 წელს SAT/ACT არასავალდებულოა, ხოლო საერთაშორისო სტუდენტების შეზღუდული რაოდენობა გულუხვ ფინანსურ დახმარებას ან სტიპენდიას იღებს.
summary.ar: جامعة بحثية خاصة شديدة الانتقائية في ناشفيل قبلت 4.6% فقط من المتقدمين لخريف 2026. اختبارات SAT/ACT اختيارية للالتحاق في 2027، ويحصل عدد محدود من الطلاب الدوليين على مساعدات سخية أو منح تفوق.

about.en:
Vanderbilt has four undergraduate schools: Arts and Science, Engineering, Peabody College of education and human development, and the Blair School of Music. Its medical centre and Nashville's music and healthcare industries create strong internship options.

In fall 2026 Vanderbilt enrolled 7,516 undergraduates (13,813 total) and admitted 2,519 of 54,792 first-year applicants. International applicants who request aid are reviewed need-aware; those admitted receive packages without loans.

SAT/ACT scores (optional: test-optional policy)

Common App personal essay (up to 650 words)
Vanderbilt short-answer essay
School counselor report + 2 teacher recommendations
CSS Profile + ISFAA if applying for aid

Audition for Blair School of Music

deadline_note: First-year (incl. international): Early Action 1 Nov 2026 (materials 10 Nov; non-NC applicants notified by 31 Jan); Regular Decision 15 Jan 2027 (materials 1 Feb; notified by 31 Mar). University Honors application due 1 Nov (NC State deadlines page).

tuition_intl.note: International students pay non-resident tuition; see NC State cost of attendance.

aid_intl.en: Very limited for international students (not eligible for federal or North Carolina state aid).

tests.en: Official English proficiency scores (TOEFL, IELTS, Duolingo or PTE) must be sent directly by the testing agency; ACT reading 27+ or SAT reading 33+ subscore can also satisfy it. See NC State's test-score page for how SAT/ACT/CLT are considered.

summary.en: A large public research university in Raleigh, part of North Carolina's Research Triangle, with strong engineering, computing, textiles and agriculture. It received 47,900 first-year applications and admitted 41%.
summary.ka: დიდი საჯარო კვლევითი უნივერსიტეტი რალეიში, ჩრდილოეთ კაროლინის კვლევითი სამკუთხედის ნაწილი, ძლიერი ინჟინერიით, კომპიუტინგით, ტექსტილითა და სოფლის მეურნეობით. 47 900 პირველკურსელის განაცხადიდან 41% მიიღეს.
summary.ar: جامعة بحثية حكومية كبيرة في رالي ضمن مثلث الأبحاث في كارولاينا الشمالية، قوية في الهندسة والحوسبة والنسيج والزراعة. تلقت 47,900 طلب للسنة الأولى وقبلت 41% منها.

about.en:
NC State is the largest university in North Carolina and sits in the Research Triangle with Duke and UNC, near tech and biotech employers. It is known for its College of Engineering, Wilson College of Textiles, College of Design and agriculture and life sciences.

International first-years follow the same Early Action and Regular Decision deadlines as US students. English test scores must be official and sent electronically; studio-based majors in Design have extra portfolio requirements.

label.en: Secondary school transcript (grades from the last 3-4 years)
English test: official TOEFL, IELTS, Duolingo or PTE score
Personal statement
Recommendation letter(s) where requested by the programme
Portfolio for studio-based Design majors
Application fee (see NC State website); fee waivers available for eligible applicants

deadline_note: Fall 2027 (main campus): application opens 1 Aug 2026; Early Action 1 Nov 2026 for priority admission and merit-aid consideration (decisions from 15 Jan 2027); applications after 1 Nov move to a rolling Regular Decision timeline (no fixed RD date confirmed on the Arizona deadlines page).

tuition_intl.note: Estimated non-Arizona-resident tuition & fees for 2027-28 (Arizona tuition & aid page); housing and food USD 17,770.

aid_intl.en: International students are not eligible for federal aid; early applicants receive priority consideration for merit aid.

tests.en: English minimums: TOEFL iBT 79 (pre-Jan 2026) or 4 (new scale), IELTS Academic 6.5, Duolingo 110, Cambridge 180/C1, PTE etc.; SAT EBRW 580 or ACT English 21 also accepted.

summary.en: A large public research university in sunny Tucson, a world leader in astronomy and planetary science and strong in optics and business. Early Action by 1 November gives priority for admission and merit aid.
summary.ka: დიდი საჯარო კვლევითი უნივერსიტეტი მზიან ტუსონში, მსოფლიო ლიდერი ასტრონომიასა და პლანეტარულ მეცნიერებაში, ძლიერი ოპტიკასა და ბიზნესში. 1 ნოემბრამდე Early Action მიღებასა და სტიპენდიაზე პრიორიტეტს იძლევა.
summary.ar: جامعة بحثية حكومية كبيرة في توسون المشمسة، رائدة عالميًا في علم الفلك وعلوم الكواكب وقوية في البصريات والأعمال. التقديم في Early Action قبل 1 نوفمبر يمنح أولوية للقبول ومنح التفوق.

about.en:
The University of Arizona leads NASA missions (such as OSIRIS-REx), builds giant telescope mirrors and has one of the top optical-sciences colleges in the US. The Eller College of Management, hydrology and nursing are also well regarded.

International applicants can apply via the Common App or Arizona's own application; English proficiency can be shown through many tests with published minimums.

label.en: Secondary school transcript (grades from the last 3-4 years)
English test: TOEFL 79 / 4, IELTS 6.5 or Duolingo 110
Personal statement (where requested)
Application fee (see Arizona website); fee waivers available for eligible applicants
Proof of funds / certification of finances for the I-20 or study permit (after admission)
Valid passport (needed for the visa / study permit)

deadline_note: One UC application covers all campuses. Fall 2027 filing period: 1-30 November 2026 (UC 'Dates & deadlines' page). No early decision/action.

tuition_intl.note: UC tuition incl. nonresident supplemental tuition, estimated for new nonresident undergraduates 2027-28 (UC tuition & cost page); campus fees, housing and food extra.

aid_intl.en: International students are not eligible for US federal or California state need-based aid. Campus scholarships for international first-years are very limited; plan to fund the full cost.

tests.en: Test-blind: SAT/ACT scores are not considered for admission. English (if required): IELTS 6.5, Duolingo 115, or TOEFL iBT 80 (tests before Jan 2026) / 4.5 on the new 1-6 scale (from Jan 2026). Some majors or campuses may expect more.

summary.en: A modern University of California campus in safe, planned Irvine in Orange County, strong in computing, informatics, biology and health sciences. Admission is test-blind through the UC application.
summary.ka: კალიფორნიის უნივერსიტეტის თანამედროვე კამპუსი ორინჯის საგრაფოს უსაფრთხო, დაგეგმილ ქალაქ ერვაინში, ძლიერი კომპიუტინგში, ინფორმატიკაში, ბიოლოგიასა და ჯანდაცვის მეცნიერებებში. SAT/ACT არ განიხილება, განაცხადი UC სისტემით იგზავნება.
summary.ar: حرم حديث لجامعة كاليفورنيا في مدينة إرفاين الآمنة والمخططة في مقاطعة أورانج، قوي في الحوسبة والمعلوماتية والأحياء والعلوم الصحية. لا تُعتبر اختبارات SAT/ACT، ويتم التقديم عبر طلب UC.

about.en:
UC Irvine's Donald Bren School of Information and Computer Sciences is one of the few stand-alone computing schools in the US, and the campus is also known for biological sciences, nursing, public health and criminology. Southern California's tech and biotech companies are close by.

For fall 2026 UC Irvine received 126,005 first-year applications and admitted 30.3% (UC admit data). International students pay UC nonresident tuition and receive little institutional aid.

deadline_note: Early Action 1 Nov 2026; Early Decision I 1 Nov 2026; Early Decision II 15 Jan 2027; Regular Decision 15 Jan 2027; Pre-Professional Scholars Program 1 Dec 2026 (CWRU deadlines & requirements page).

tuition_intl.note: See CWRU cost & aid page for current tuition.

aid_intl.en: International students are automatically considered for several merit scholarships, and can apply for others including full-tuition awards.

tests.en: Test-optional (40% of students enrolled without tests). English minimums for non-native speakers: Duolingo 115, IELTS 7, PTE 61, TOEFL iBT 90 (before 21 Jan 2026) / 4.5 (from 21 Jan 2026); SAT EBRW 630+ or ACT English 26+ also accepted.

scholarships.name: CWRU merit scholarships (automatic + competitive full-tuition awards)

summary.en: A private research university in Cleveland's University Circle, renowned for biomedical engineering, nursing and pre-health paths next to world-class hospitals. International students are automatically considered for merit scholarships.
summary.ka: კერძო კვლევითი უნივერსიტეტი კლივლენდის University Circle-ში, ცნობილი ბიოსამედიცინო ინჟინერიით, საექთნო საქმითა და მედიცინისკენ მიმავალი გზებით მსოფლიო დონის საავადმყოფოების გვერდით. საერთაშორისო სტუდენტები ავტომატურად განიხილებიან სტიპენდიებისთვის.
summary.ar: جامعة بحثية خاصة في منطقة University Circle بكليفلاند، تشتهر بالهندسة الطبية الحيوية والتمريض ومسارات التحضير للمهن الصحية بجوار مستشفيات عالمية. يُنظر تلقائيًا في منح التفوق للطلاب الدوليين.

about.en:
CWRU sits beside the Cleveland Clinic and University Hospitals, giving students research and clinical opportunities from the first year. Engineering, nursing, biology and pre-professional scholars programmes (guaranteed medical, dental or law school pathways) are standouts.

The Early Action round is non-binding, and Early Decision I/II are binding. The middle 50% superscored SAT is 1440-1520 and ACT 33-35, though 40% of high-school applicants were test-optional.

deadline_note: Restrictive Early Action 1 Nov 2026 (aid priority 15 Nov); Regular Decision 4 Jan 2027 (Notre Dame admissions important dates).

tuition_intl.note: See Notre Dame financial aid / cost of attendance page.

aid_intl.en: Need-blind admission for international first-year applicants; those who want need-based aid must complete the CSS Profile. Notre Dame meets full demonstrated need.

tests.en: Test-optional for fall 2027 applicants; SAT/ACT will be required again from fall 2028 entry. English proficiency evidence for non-native speakers (see international applicants page).

scholarships.name: Notre Dame need-based aid for international students (need-blind)

summary.en: A leading Catholic research university in Indiana with a strong residential community, top business school and famous football tradition. It is need-blind for international applicants and test-optional for fall 2027.
summary.ka: წამყვანი კათოლიკური კვლევითი უნივერსიტეტი ინდიანაში, ძლიერი საცხოვრებელი თემით, საუკეთესო ბიზნეს სკოლითა და ცნობილი ფეხბურთის ტრადიციით. საერთაშორისო აპლიკანტებისთვის need-blind-ია და 2027 წლის შემოდგომაზე ტესტები არასავალდებულოა.
summary.ar: جامعة بحثية كاثوليكية رائدة في إنديانا بمجتمع سكني قوي وكلية أعمال متميزة وتقليد كرة قدم شهير. لا تأخذ الحاجة المالية في الاعتبار عند قبول الدوليين، والاختبارات اختيارية لخريف 2027.

about.en:
Nearly all Notre Dame undergraduates live in one of its residence halls, which act as lifelong communities. The Mendoza College of Business is consistently top-ranked, and the university is strong in economics, political science, engineering and pre-health.

Notre Dame is need-blind for international applicants and will reinstate a testing requirement from the 2027-28 cycle (fall 2028 entry); fall 2027 applicants can still apply test-optional.

Notre Dame supplemental essays

Financial aid forms if requesting aid (CSS Profile and/or the university's international aid form)

deadline_note: Early Action (non-binding) 1 Nov 2026 for highest admission and scholarship consideration; Regular Decision 1 Feb 2027 (IU Bloomington first-year deadlines page).

tuition_intl.note: See IU Bloomington cost & aid pages for non-resident tuition.

aid_intl.en: Merit-based academic awards and country-specific scholarships for incoming international first-years (e.g. C.V. Starr Foundation Scholarship).

tests.en: Test-optional admission. English minimums: TOEFL iBT 79, IELTS 6.5, Duolingo 115, Cambridge English 176, PTE and others listed on IU's English proficiency page.

scholarships.name: IU Bloomington international student scholarships

summary.en: Indiana's flagship campus in a classic college town, home to the top-ranked Kelley School of Business and the Jacobs School of Music. It is test-optional and awards merit scholarships to international first-years.
summary.ka: ინდიანას წამყვანი კამპუსი კლასიკურ საუნივერსიტეტო ქალაქში, სადაც მდებარეობს მაღალრეიტინგული Kelley ბიზნეს სკოლა და Jacobs მუსიკის სკოლა. ტესტები არასავალდებულოა და საერთაშორისო პირველკურსელებს სტიპენდიებს სთავაზობს.
summary.ar: الحرم الرئيسي لجامعة إنديانا في مدينة جامعية تقليدية، ويضم كلية كيلي للأعمال المتميزة ومدرسة جاكوبز للموسيقى. الاختبارات اختيارية، وتمنح منح تفوق للطلاب الدوليين الجدد.

about.en:
IU Bloomington offers 200+ majors on one of the most beautiful campuses in the US. The Kelley School of Business, the Jacobs School of Music (one of the largest music schools in the world), the O'Neill School of Public and Environmental Affairs and the Luddy School of Informatics are standouts.

Applying by the 1 November Early Action deadline gives the highest consideration for admission and scholarships; international freshmen are considered for merit and country-specific awards.

deadline_note: Fall 2027 application window 1 Oct 2026 - 31 Jan 2027 (SFU admission page); some programmes have earlier supplementary deadlines.

tuition_intl.note: International tuition and fees (incl. transit pass) for a typical first year, SFU fees & scholarships page; residence with meal plan about CAD 15,014.

aid_intl.en: Entrance scholarships for Canadian and international high-school applicants worth CAD 20,000-140,000 (USES); need-based bursaries and work-study also available.

tests.en: SAT/ACT not required. English proficiency required for international applicants (see SFU's English requirements).

scholarships.name: SFU entrance scholarships (USES), CAD 20,000-140,000

summary.en: A comprehensive British Columbia university on Burnaby Mountain near Vancouver, known for co-op, computing, business and communication. The fall 2027 application window closes on 31 January.
summary.ka: ბრიტანეთის კოლუმბიის კომპლექსური უნივერსიტეტი ბერნაბის მთაზე, ვანკუვერის მახლობლად; ცნობილია co-op პროგრამით, კომპიუტინგით, ბიზნესითა და კომუნიკაციით. 2027 წლის შემოდგომის განაცხადის ვადა 31 იანვარს იხურება.
summary.ar: جامعة شاملة في كولومبيا البريطانية على جبل بورنابي قرب فانكوفر، تشتهر ببرامج التعليم التعاوني والحوسبة والأعمال والاتصال. تُغلق نافذة التقديم لخريف 2027 في 31 يناير.

about.en:
SFU has campuses in Burnaby, Vancouver and Surrey and one of Canada's largest co-operative education programmes. It is known for computing science, the Beedie School of Business, communication, criminology and kinesiology.

International high-school applicants apply online between 1 October and 31 January for fall entry. Total first-year cost for an international student living in residence is roughly CAD 57,000 including tuition, housing, insurance and supplies.

deadline_note: Fall 2027 first-year: Early Action 1 Nov 2026 (decision by 31 Jan 2027); Regular Decision 1 Dec 2026 (decision by 28 Feb 2027); reply by 1 May (Rutgers dates & deadlines page).

tuition_intl.note: See Rutgers tuition and fees for out-of-state/international rates.

aid_intl.en: Limited for international students (not eligible for federal or New Jersey state aid); some merit scholarships are considered at admission.

tests.en: English minimums (New Brunswick): TOEFL iBT 79 (to 21 Jan 2026) or 4.5 (from 22 Jan 2026), IELTS 6.5, Duolingo 115, PTE 53, MET 56, Cambridge B2, SAT EBRW 550 or ACT English 21. Pharmacy and Nursing require higher scores (e.g. TOEFL 100 / 5.5).

summary.en: The flagship campus of New Jersey's state university, between New York City and Philadelphia, with strong pharmacy, computer science, business and philosophy. Regular Decision closes on 1 December.
summary.ka: ნიუ-ჯერსის შტატის უნივერსიტეტის მთავარი კამპუსი ნიუ-იორკსა და ფილადელფიას შორის, ძლიერი ფარმაციით, კომპიუტერული მეცნიერებით, ბიზნესითა და ფილოსოფიით. Regular Decision 1 დეკემბერს იხურება.
summary.ar: الحرم الرئيسي لجامعة ولاية نيوجيرسي بين نيويورك وفيلادلفيا، ويتميز بالصيدلة وعلوم الحاسوب والأعمال والفلسفة. تُغلق جولة Regular Decision في 1 ديسمبر.

about.en:
Rutgers-New Brunswick is a large research university and member of the Big Ten, about an hour by train from New York City. It offers 100+ majors, including the highly competitive Ernest Mario School of Pharmacy and School of Nursing, strong computer science and business, and one of the top philosophy departments in the US.

International applicants submit English test results (minimums differ for Pharmacy and Nursing) and academic records; the Early Action round on 1 November gives an earlier decision.

label.en: Secondary school transcript (grades from the last 3-4 years)
English test: TOEFL 79 / 4.5, IELTS 6.5, Duolingo 115 (higher for Pharmacy/Nursing)
Personal essay
Application fee (see Rutgers website); fee waivers available for eligible applicants
Proof of funds / certification of finances for the I-20 or study permit (after admission)
Valid passport (needed for the visa / study permit)

deadline_note: International deadlines vary by programme; see York's 'Deadlines and Costs' section for international applicants. Applying early is recommended for scholarship consideration.

tuition_intl.note: Approximate international tuition for most Arts and Sciences programmes (business about CAD 40,000-44,000), York tuition page.

aid_intl.en: Entrance scholarships for international students, including the President's International Scholarship of Excellence (CAD 180,000 over 4 years) and programme awards such as the CAD 25,000 Yavin Family International Science Student Scholarship.

tests.en: SAT/ACT not required. English proficiency required for applicants whose first language is not English (see York international requirements).

scholarships.name: President's International Scholarship of Excellence (CAD 180,000 over 4 years)
York international scholarships

summary.en: Canada's third-largest university, in Toronto, home to the Schulich School of Business, the Lassonde engineering school and a bilingual Glendon campus. It offers big entrance scholarships for international students.
summary.ka: კანადის მესამე უდიდესი უნივერსიტეტი ტორონტოში — Schulich ბიზნეს სკოლის, Lassonde-ის საინჟინრო სკოლისა და ორენოვანი Glendon კამპუსის სახლი. საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებს დიდ შესასვლელ სტიპენდიებს სთავაზობს.
summary.ar: ثالث أكبر جامعة في كندا، في تورنتو، وتضم كلية شوليك للأعمال وكلية لاسوند للهندسة وحرم غليندون ثنائي اللغة. تقدم منح دخول كبيرة للطلاب الدوليين.

about.en:
York has campuses at Keele, Glendon (a bilingual English-French liberal-arts campus) and Markham, and is known for business, law and society, fine arts and media, and kinesiology. Toronto's job market and York's co-op and experiential-learning options are major draws.

International tuition for most programmes is around CAD 40,000 per year. The President's International Scholarship of Excellence is worth CAD 45,000 a year for four years for top international high-school applicants with strong leadership and service.

label.en: Secondary school transcript (grades from the last 3-4 years)
Secondary school diploma / final exam results (predicted results accepted when applying)
OUAC 105 online application (international applicants to Ontario universities)
English test: required for non-native speakers
Supplementary application for some programmes (e.g. fine arts, business)
Application fee (see OUAC/York)
Proof of funds / certification of finances for the I-20 or study permit (after admission)
Valid passport (needed for the visa / study permit)

deadline_note: Early Decision I 2 Nov 2026; Early Decision II and Regular Decision 4 Jan 2027 (Tufts admissions homepage 'Upcoming deadlines').

tuition_intl.note: See Tufts tuition & aid page.

aid_intl.en: Tufts meets 100% of demonstrated financial need of every admitted student, regardless of citizenship.

tests.en: Test-optional (about half of applicants submit). Enrolled mid-50%: SAT EBRW 730-770, SAT Math 740-790, ACT 33-35. English: no minimums, but successful applicants typically have TOEFL iBT 100+ (or 5.0+ new scale), IELTS 7+, PTE 68+, Duolingo 130+.

gpa_note.en: Enrolled mid-50%: SAT EBRW 730-770, Math 740-790, ACT 33-35.

scholarships.name: Tufts need-based financial aid for international students

summary.en: A private research university just outside Boston, known for international relations, pre-med and engineering, and for its active-citizenship ethos. It meets full demonstrated need for every admitted student, including international students.
summary.ka: კერძო კვლევითი უნივერსიტეტი ბოსტონის გარეუბანში, ცნობილი საერთაშორისო ურთიერთობებით, მედიცინისთვის მომზადებითა და ინჟინერიით, აქტიური მოქალაქეობის კულტურით. ყველა ჩარიცხულის, მათ შორის საერთაშორისო სტუდენტების, დადასტურებულ საჭიროებას სრულად ფარავს.
summary.ar: جامعة بحثية خاصة على أطراف بوسطن، تشتهر بالعلاقات الدولية والتحضير للطب والهندسة وروح المواطنة الفاعلة. تغطي الحاجة المثبتة كاملة لكل الطلاب المقبولين، بمن فيهم الدوليون.

about.en:
Tufts combines a liberal-arts college feel with a research university, including the Fletcher School of international affairs and a School of Engineering. More than 40% of students study abroad, and there are combined degrees with the School of the Museum of Fine Arts and the New England Conservatory.

Tufts is test-optional and meets full demonstrated need for all admitted students regardless of citizenship (international aid applicants are reviewed with their aid request in mind).

label.en: Secondary school transcript (grades from the last 3-4 years)
SAT/ACT scores (optional: test-optional policy)
English test: recommended: TOEFL 100 / 5.0, IELTS 7, Duolingo 130, PTE 68
Common App personal essay (up to 650 words)
Tufts supplemental essays
School counselor report + 2 teacher recommendations
Application fee (see Tufts website); fee waivers available for eligible applicants
Financial aid forms if requesting aid (CSS Profile and/or the university's international aid form)

deadline_note: Fall 2027 first-year: Early Action 2 Nov 2026 (application complete with all documents); Regular Decision 1 Feb 2027 (UIC requirements & deadlines page).

tuition_intl.note: See UIC tuition & financial aid page.

aid_intl.en: Limited for international students; some UIC scholarships (e.g. via the Honors College) require separate applications.

tests.en: English minimums: TOEFL iBT 80 or 4.5 (new scale), IELTS Academic 6.5, PTE 54, Duolingo 120 (accepted from fall 2027).

summary.en: Chicago's largest university, in the heart of the city, with a big medical centre and strong health sciences, engineering and computer science. It is one of the most diverse research universities in the US.
summary.ka: ჩიკაგოს უდიდესი უნივერსიტეტი ქალაქის ცენტრში, დიდი სამედიცინო ცენტრით და ძლიერი ჯანდაცვის მეცნიერებებით, ინჟინერიითა და კომპიუტერული მეცნიერებით. აშშ-ის ერთ-ერთი ყველაზე მრავალფეროვანი კვლევითი უნივერსიტეტი.
summary.ar: أكبر جامعة في شيكاغو، في قلب المدينة، ولديها مركز طبي كبير وبرامج قوية في العلوم الصحية والهندسة وعلوم الحاسوب. من أكثر الجامعات البحثية تنوعًا في الولايات المتحدة.

about.en:
UIC is part of the University of Illinois system and home to the largest medical school in the US, so nursing, pharmacy, public health and pre-health tracks are strong. Engineering, computer science and the College of Architecture, Design and the Arts are also popular, with the Chicago job market on the doorstep.

International first-years can apply Early Action by 2 November or Regular Decision by 1 February and must meet published English minimums.

label.en: Secondary school transcript (grades from the last 3-4 years)
English test: TOEFL 80 / 4.5, IELTS 6.5, Duolingo 120, PTE 54
Personal statement
Application fee (see UIC website); fee waivers available for eligible applicants
Proof of funds / certification of finances for the I-20 or study permit (after admission)
Valid passport (needed for the visa / study permit)

deadline_note: Most degree programmes: 31 Jan 2027 for September 2027 entry; early admission possible for those who apply and submit grades by early December (UVic application deadlines page).

tuition_intl.note: See UVic tuition & costs page (estimator) for international tuition.

aid_intl.en: Entrance scholarships and funding for international students; see UVic scholarships & funding page.

tests.en: SAT/ACT not required. English proficiency required for applicants whose first language is not English (see UVic international page).

scholarships.name: UVic scholarships & funding

summary.en: A research university on Vancouver Island in the small, coastal city of Victoria, known for ocean and climate science, co-op and a relaxed West Coast lifestyle. Most programmes close applications on 31 January.
summary.ka: კვლევითი უნივერსიტეტი ვანკუვერის კუნძულზე, პატარა სანაპირო ქალაქ ვიქტორიაში; ცნობილია ოკეანისა და კლიმატის მეცნიერებით, co-op პროგრამებითა და დასავლეთ სანაპიროს მშვიდი ცხოვრებით. უმეტეს პროგრამაზე განაცხადი 31 იანვარს იხურება.
summary.ar: جامعة بحثية في جزيرة فانكوفر بمدينة فيكتوريا الساحلية الصغيرة، تشتهر بعلوم المحيطات والمناخ والتعليم التعاوني وأسلوب حياة الساحل الغربي الهادئ. تُغلق معظم البرامج التقديم في 31 يناير.

about.en:
UVic hosts Ocean Networks Canada and major climate research institutes, and runs one of Canada's largest co-op programmes across engineering, computer science, business and the sciences. It is mid-sized and campus-focused, in a city often ranked among the best small cities in the world.

International students apply online; those who submit completed grades early (by December) can receive early offers.

English test: required for non-native speakers
Application fee (see UVic website)
Proof of funds / certification of finances for the I-20 or study permit (after admission)
Valid passport (needed for the visa / study permit)

name.en: Virginia Tech (Virginia Polytechnic Institute and State University)

deadline_note: International first-year: Early Action 15 Nov 2026 (materials and English scores by 1 Dec); Regular Decision 15 Jan 2027 (materials by 24 Jan). General scholarship application priority deadline 22 Jan (Virginia Tech admissions pages).

tuition_intl.note: See Virginia Tech cost & aid page for non-resident tuition.

aid_intl.en: Limited for international students; Virginia Tech's general scholarship application (priority deadline 22 Jan) is used for university scholarships.

tests.en: English: TOEFL iBT 80 (no subsection below 16) or 4.5 on the new scale (no subsection below 4.0), IELTS 6.5 (no sub-score below 6.5), Duolingo 115, PTE 59, Cambridge 176; SAT EBRW 550 or ACT English 24 also accepted.

scholarships.name: Virginia Tech university scholarships

summary.en: Virginia's large public land-grant university in the Blue Ridge Mountains, known for engineering, architecture and agriculture and a strong school spirit. International applicants can apply Early Action by 15 November.
summary.ka: ვირჯინიის დიდი საჯარო უნივერსიტეტი ბლუ-რიჯის მთებში, ცნობილი ინჟინერიით, არქიტექტურითა და სოფლის მეურნეობით, ძლიერი სტუდენტური სულისკვეთებით. საერთაშორისო აპლიკანტებს Early Action-ით 15 ნოემბრამდე შეუძლიათ განაცხადის შეტანა.
summary.ar: جامعة حكومية كبيرة في فرجينيا وسط جبال بلو ريدج، تشتهر بالهندسة والعمارة والزراعة وروح جامعية قوية. يمكن للمتقدمين الدوليين التقديم في Early Action حتى 15 نوفمبر.

about.en:
Virginia Tech's College of Engineering is one of the largest in the US, and its architecture, agriculture and business programmes are well regarded. The university also runs an Innovation Campus near Washington, D.C. focused on computing.

International applicants must report English test results by the materials deadline of their round. Students who completed four years in English-medium schools may be exempt.

label.en: Secondary school transcript (grades from the last 3-4 years)
English test: TOEFL 80 / 4.5, IELTS 6.5, Duolingo 115
Common App personal essay (up to 650 words)
Virginia Tech ungraded short-answer questions
Application fee (see Virginia Tech website); fee waivers available for eligible applicants
Proof of funds / certification of finances for the I-20 or study permit (after admission)
Valid passport (needed for the visa / study permit)

deadline_note: Fall 2027 first-year: Early Action (non-binding) 1 Nov 2026; Honors College priority 15 Dec 2026; Regular Decision application completion deadline 1 Feb 2027, then rolling until capacity (UB admissions dates page).

tuition_intl.note: See UB tuition and estimated costs page for international rates.

aid_intl.en: Limited for international students; UB lists international financial details on its costs pages and some merit scholarships via the Honors College.

tests.en: International applicants must show English proficiency (see UB international application page).

summary.en: The largest campus of the State University of New York system, with strong engineering, pharmacy, business and architecture and a large international community. Early Action closes on 1 November.
summary.ka: ნიუ-იორკის შტატის უნივერსიტეტის (SUNY) უდიდესი კამპუსი, ძლიერი ინჟინერიით, ფარმაციით, ბიზნესითა და არქიტექტურით, დიდი საერთაშორისო თემით. Early Action 1 ნოემბერს იხურება.
summary.ar: أكبر حرم في نظام جامعة ولاية نيويورك، ولديه برامج قوية في الهندسة والصيدلة والأعمال والعمارة ومجتمع دولي كبير. تُغلق جولة Early Action في 1 نوفمبر.

about.en:
UB is a large public research university in western New York, close to Niagara Falls and the Canadian border. It has one of the biggest international student populations among US public universities and is known for engineering, pharmacy, management and architecture.

Applying Early Action gives an earlier decision without commitment; Regular Decision applications should be complete by 1 February, after which UB continues to review until programmes fill.
