English test: required for non-native speakers
Personal essay (recommended)
Application fee (see UB website); fee waivers available for eligible applicants
Proof of funds / certification of finances for the I-20 or study permit (after admission)
Valid passport (needed for the visa / study permit)

deadline_note: One UC application covers all campuses. Fall 2027 filing period: 1-30 November 2026 (UC 'Dates & deadlines' page). No early decision/action.

tuition_intl.note: UC tuition incl. nonresident supplemental tuition, estimated for new nonresident undergraduates 2027-28 (UC tuition & cost page); campus fees, housing and food extra.

aid_intl.en: International students are automatically considered for UCR's Achievement Scholarship for Nonresident Students (renewable while keeping a 3.0 GPA). No federal or state need-based aid for internationals.

tests.en: Test-blind: SAT/ACT scores are not considered for admission. English (if required): IELTS 6.5, Duolingo 115, or TOEFL iBT 80 (tests before Jan 2026) / 4.5 on the new 1-6 scale (from Jan 2026). Some majors or campuses may expect more.

scholarships.name: Achievement Scholarship for Nonresident Students (automatic)

summary.en: The most accessible University of California campus, in inland Southern California, with strengths in agricultural science, business and engineering. International students are automatically considered for a nonresident scholarship.
summary.ka: კალიფორნიის უნივერსიტეტის ყველაზე ხელმისაწვდომი კამპუსი სამხრეთ კალიფორნიის შიდა ნაწილში, ძლიერი სოფლის მეურნეობის მეცნიერებებში, ბიზნესსა და ინჟინერიაში. საერთაშორისო სტუდენტები ავტომატურად განიხილებიან არარეზიდენტის სტიპენდიისთვის.
summary.ar: أكثر حرم جامعة كاليفورنيا إتاحةً للقبول، في داخل جنوب كاليفورنيا، ويتميز بالعلوم الزراعية والأعمال والهندسة. يُنظر تلقائيًا في منح الطلاب الدوليين منحة لغير المقيمين.

about.en:
UC Riverside is a diverse research campus about an hour east of Los Angeles, with the UC's historic Citrus Experiment Station, a School of Business and a growing engineering college. It gives a UC degree with a much higher admit rate than the coastal campuses.

For fall 2026 UC Riverside received 72,542 first-year applications and admitted 88.2% (UC admit data). International students pay UC nonresident tuition; UCR automatically considers them for its Achievement Scholarship for Nonresident Students.

tuition_intl.note: See Stony Brook cost & aid page for out-of-state/international tuition.

aid_intl.en: Limited for international students (not eligible for federal or New York State aid); merit scholarships may be considered at admission.

tests.en: Test-optional. Fall 2025 first-years who submitted scores: SAT 1350-1470, ACT 30-34 (middle 50%). English proficiency via official TOEFL, Duolingo, IELTS, PTE Academic, SAT, ACT, AP, IB or A-Level results.

gpa_note.en: Fall 2025 first-year middle 50%: high-school GPA 3.7-4.0 (92-98 on a 100 scale).

summary.en: A flagship research campus of the State University of New York on Long Island, strong in computer science, applied maths and the life sciences. It is test-optional and admitted 48% of applicants for fall 2025.
summary.ka: ნიუ-იორკის შტატის უნივერსიტეტის (SUNY) წამყვანი კვლევითი კამპუსი ლონგ-აილენდზე, ძლიერი კომპიუტერულ მეცნიერებაში, გამოყენებით მათემატიკასა და ბიოლოგიურ მეცნიერებებში. ტესტები არასავალდებულოა; 2025 წლის შემოდგომაზე აპლიკანტების 48% მიიღეს.
summary.ar: حرم بحثي رئيسي لجامعة ولاية نيويورك (SUNY) في لونغ آيلاند، قوي في علوم الحاسوب والرياضيات التطبيقية وعلوم الحياة. الاختبارات اختيارية، وقُبل 48% من المتقدمين لخريف 2025.

about.en:
Stony Brook is about 90 minutes from New York City, manages Brookhaven National Laboratory jointly and has a large academic medical centre. Computer science, applied mathematics and statistics, biology and engineering are particularly strong.

Fall 2025 enrolled 3,964 first-years; the middle 50% of score submitters had SAT 1350-1470. International applicants send transcripts in English and an official English proficiency result.

SAT/ACT scores (optional: test-optional policy)
English test: official TOEFL / Duolingo / IELTS / PTE (or SAT, ACT, AP, IB, A-Level English)
Personal essay
Recommendation letter(s) where requested by the programme
Application fee (see Stony Brook website); fee waivers available for eligible applicants
Proof of funds / certification of finances for the I-20 or study permit (after admission)

name.en: University of California, Santa Cruz (UC Santa Cruz)

deadline_note: One UC application covers all campuses. Fall 2027 filing period: 1-30 November 2026 (UC 'Dates & deadlines' page). No early decision/action.

tuition_intl.note: UC tuition incl. nonresident supplemental tuition, estimated for new nonresident undergraduates 2027-28 (UC tuition & cost page); campus fees, housing and food extra.

aid_intl.en: International students are not eligible for US federal or California state need-based aid. Campus scholarships for international first-years are very limited; plan to fund the full cost.

tests.en: Test-blind: SAT/ACT scores are not considered for admission. English (if required): IELTS 6.5, Duolingo 115, or TOEFL iBT 80 (tests before Jan 2026) / 4.5 on the new 1-6 scale (from Jan 2026). Some majors or campuses may expect more.

gpa_note.en: Middle 50% high-school GPA of fall 2026 admits: 3.79-4.20 (UC admit data).

summary.en: A University of California campus set in redwood forest above Monterey Bay, near Silicon Valley, known for computer game design, astronomy and environmental science. Admission is test-blind through the UC application.
summary.ka: კალიფორნიის უნივერსიტეტის კამპუსი წითელი ხის ტყეში, მონტერეის ყურის თავზე, სილიკონის ველის მახლობლად; ცნობილია კომპიუტერული თამაშების დიზაინით, ასტრონომიითა და გარემოს მეცნიერებით. SAT/ACT არ განიხილება.
summary.ar: حرم لجامعة كاليفورنيا وسط غابات الخشب الأحمر فوق خليج مونتيري قرب وادي السيليكون، يشتهر بتصميم ألعاب الحاسوب وعلم الفلك وعلوم البيئة. لا تُعتبر اختبارات SAT/ACT.

about.en:
UC Santa Cruz is organised into ten residential colleges on a forested hillside campus overlooking the ocean. It runs the UC's Lick Observatory, is a leader in genomics, and its computational media and game design programmes are well regarded; Silicon Valley is about 45 minutes away.

For fall 2026 UC Santa Cruz received 79,048 first-year applications and admitted 82.1% (UC admit data). International students pay UC nonresident tuition and receive little institutional aid.

No SAT/ACT needed (scores not considered)
English test: IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL 80 (old scale) or 4.5 (new scale) / Duolingo 115
